acceptance: No deep or top seat can reach a model older than the current generation of its family: the agy deep and top tier_fallbacks hold no Gemini 3.1 Pro or Gemini 3.5 Flash model, and a test pins the rule where the fallback lists are authored or refreshed
The manifests' default_model values and the agy.json model_tier_map name no older model that a deep or top dispatch can receive, or each one is shown unreachable
A seat whose latest model is unavailable walks to the next family in cli_routing, as before (no routing change)
fix: Make the rule 'a fallback steps only to a current-generation model' hold where the fallback lists come from (the catalog refresh and its MergeFallbacks preservation, and the manifests), and drop the older entries. Do not change cli_routing.
routed_reason: operator decision 2026-10-21 on within-tier-model-fallback: a within-tier fallback may step only to a current-generation model; the catalog and manifests are operator configuration
summary: The operator rejected the within-tier model failover on 2026-10-21 because 'it should always leverage the latest model, 3.1 pro is way to old'. bridge.model_failover stays off, so today no dispatch walks these lists, but they still name older models that a deep or top seat could reach if the axis or another reader used them. Found 2026-10-21: (1) runtime/.evolve/model-catalog.json agy deep tier_fallbacks = [Gemini 3.1 Pro (High), Gemini 3.5 Flash (Medium), Gemini 3.5 Flash (Low)] after the primary Gemini 4 Argon (Medium); (2) agy top tier_fallbacks = the same three after Gemini 4 Argon (High); (3) go/internal/bridge/manifests/agy-tmux.json default_model = gemini-3.5-flash; (4) go/internal/bridge/manifests/agy.json default_model = gemini-3.5-flash and model_tier_map maps every tier, deep and top included, to gemini-3.5-flash (its model_tier channel is noop, so the value may never reach the CLI; confirm). Not older but to confirm: claude deep and top tier_fallbacks = [opus, sonnet] step to Sonnet, a current-generation but smaller model. The current agy generation is Gemini 4 Argon and Gemini 3.8 Flash; agy-claude deep and top hold Claude Opus 5.5 with no fallbacks.
title: The catalog and manifest fallback lists still name older models (Gemini 3.1 Pro, Gemini 3.5 Flash) that a deep or top seat could reach
